title: Auto Tool Switch
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Switches to best tool automatically.
body:
Developed by the @TheEpitex YouTube channel, this innovative mod brings a new level of efficiency to your gameplay. It intelligently monitors the specific block you are targeting or the action you are currently performing, then automatically switches to the most effective tool for that task from your hotbar. By eliminating the need for manual item swapping, it allows you to maintain your focus and workflow, ensuring you are always equipped with the perfect gear for any situation.
